title: Conventional-dynamics challenge to the SDSS DR20 young-old current-field result

immutability.rule: No v2 threshold or decision rule may be changed after a v2 young-old outcome statistic is inspected.

fixed_primary_inputs.age_catalog: SDSS DR20 gyrochronology dwarf VAC gyro_age_dwarf-1.0.0.fits
fixed_primary_inputs.chemistry_preferred: SDSS DR20 BOSS-CLAM [Fe/H] and [alpha/M] with recommended-quality flags
inherit_from_v1: base 0.25 x 0.25 x 0.10 kpc voxel grid
10 stars per cohort per supported voxel

test_A_asymmetric_drift.jeans_equation: V_c^2 - mean(v_phi)^2 = sigma_phi^2 - sigma_R^2 * [1 + d ln(nu sigma_R^2)/d ln R] - (R/nu) d(nu <v_R v_z>)/dz
test_A_asymmetric_drift.tracer_density_warning: nu is catalog tracer density, not stellar mass density

radial_gradient.fit: equal-bin-weight linear regression of ln(nu sigma_R^2) on ln R
radial_gradient.age_handling: same fitted local gradient applied to young and old at matched R and |z|

tilt_term.mandatory_sensitivity: measured <v_R v_z> with centered finite-difference vertical derivative when adjacent 0.1 kpc layers exist

test_A_asymmetric_drift.primary_estimand: equal-voxel mean of observed Delta v_phi minus predicted Delta v_phi_AD
sufficiency_conditions: observed equal-voxel Delta v_phi lies inside two-sided 95% bootstrap prediction interval of Delta v_phi_AD
within-voxel permutation p for residual azimuthal contrast is > 0.01

test_B_population_and_selection.underpowered_rule: Do not relax bin widths or thresholds after outcome inspection.

test_D_replication.disjointness: exclude every Gaia source_id appearing anywhere in the SDSS DR20 gyrochronology VAC before cohort assignment

success.direction_rule: component-by-component residual sign agreement for every primary component with absolute residual > 2 km/s

interpretation.asymmetric_drift_sufficient: Treat the v1 ~20.5 km/s azimuthal difference as conventionally explained unless a separate non-azimuthal and replicated residual survives.
interpretation.vphi_dominated: Do not treat the v1 omnibus rejection as independent support for persistence.
interpretation.chemistry_or_selection_sensitive: Classify as population/selection-confounded if an adequately powered stress test removes the residual.
survival_requires: Test A says asymmetric drift insufficient
no adequately powered chemistry or selection stress test eliminates the residual
interpretation.prohibited_claim: No v2 outcome is a detection of gravitational persistence.

execution_lock: No v2 outcome calculation may begin until both the human-readable and machine-readable v2 protocol authorities are committed. Scientifically material changes require a new protocol version.
